benchmark: EGDDM D6.3 signed execution receipt and transparency verification

cases.setup: Complete in-toto Statement/v1, exact predicateType, trusted runner identity, verified DSSE envelope, matching immutable subject.
cases.claim_boundary: Does not establish that the test result is accurate.

cases.setup: Separately signed SLSA Provenance v1.2 Statement; subject digest matches output; signer-builder pair is explicitly trusted.
Separately signed in-toto Test Result v0.1 Statement; subject and configuration match the EGDDM predicate.
cases.claim_boundary: Does not establish the runner platform trust base by itself.

cases.setup: Independent grader identity is distinct from agent and runner identities and permitted by relying-party policy.
cases.claim_boundary: Does not prove task or oracle validity.

cases.setup: Agent-signed statement carries a workload identity and exact scope but no runner execution block.
cases.claim_boundary: Must never satisfy runner or grader requirements.

cases.setup: Authority-service statement carries policy digest, operation, scope and validity window but no runner execution block.
cases.claim_boundary: Does not prove the proposed action is safe.

cases.setup: Signed statement has a valid SCITT or Rekor receipt, inclusion proof, accepted checkpoint and consistency with persisted prior checkpoint.
Bundle contains independently valid agent, runner and grader envelopes; each is checked individually and required roles are present.
cases.claim_boundary: Bundle container itself is not authenticated.

cases.setup: Claim kind is runner_execution while producer role is agent.
Claim kind is independent_regrade while producer workload identity resolves to the candidate agent identity.
SLSA statement subject digest differs from EGDDM output artifact digest.
SLSA provenance is correctly signed but builder.id is not in the allowed signer-builder pair set.
SLSA Build Provenance is supplied in place of required in-toto Test Result.
in-toto Test Result is supplied in place of required SLSA build provenance.
Any signed payload byte, subject, predicate, outcome or timestamp is modified after signing.
Signature is cryptographically valid but issuer identity is expired, revoked or outside policy.
Repository, revision, tree, configuration-world or artifact subject does not match the requested obligation.
The same challenge ID or nonce digest is presented for a second attempt.
Challenge is expired before execution completed.
Challenge was issued for a different repository, tree, obligation, runner policy or operation.
Challenge consumption outcome is unknown after a crash or timeout.
Authority decision expired or permitted scope/operation does not cover the attempted action.
Required transparency receipt or inclusion proof is absent.
Inclusion proof does not verify against the accepted signed checkpoint.
New checkpoint is inconsistent with persisted prior checkpoint.
Two transparency services/witnesses return divergent histories for the same statement sequence.
Bundle omits the independent-grader envelope required by policy.
Bundle injects an invalid or irrelevant envelope alongside valid required envelopes.
Bundle entry order is permuted without changing its entries.
A correctly signed and logged pass is superseded or revoked by a later valid statement.
A trusted runner signs and logs a false pass assertion.
A producer selectively omits a failed run or conflicting statement from the required evidence history.
Signer is approved but builder.id is unknown, or builder is approved but signer is unknown.

claim_ceiling: Test design only. No case has been executed against a cryptographic verifier or live transparency service; expected outcomes are planned policy behaviors, not observed results.
